author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam introduces another build he's been slowing tackling over the course of this year: a 1/35 scale replica of the ship Sirius as depicted in The Adventures of Tintin: Red Rackham's Treasure! The art of Tintin was hugely influential to Adam growing up, and he pays tribute to Hergé's art with the detailing and painting of this meter-long scale model. 

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Joey Fameli
Music by Jinglepunks
